name: @peasant-labs/fairtrade
description: Private fairtrade design-system library: canonical tokens, base styles, component CSS, and React UI exports.

scripts.gen:check: node scripts/gen-llm-artifacts.mjs && git diff --exit-code public/tokens.json public/components.json packages/tokens/tokens.css packages/tokens/tokens.json packages/tokens/base.css packages/tokens/fonts.css
scripts.build:app: node scripts/gen-llm-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/contrast.mjs && vite build
scripts.build:lib: pnpm test:contract && node scripts/gen-llm-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/contrast.mjs && vite build --config vite.lib.config.js && vite build --config vite.lib-css.config.js && node scripts/finalize-lib-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && node scripts/smoke-lib.mjs && node scripts/smoke-transcript.mjs && node scripts/smoke-transcript-ui.mjs && node scripts/contrast.mjs --css dist/lib/tokens.css && node scripts/assert-pack-contents.mjs
scripts.build:all: pnpm build && pnpm build-storybook && rm -rf dist/storybook && cp -r storybook-static dist/storybook
